subject: S050
speed_method: magnitude horizontal OpenSim pelvis displacement / stride duration; not directly measured walking speed
timing: original samples and durations preserved; phases added without temporal resampling
phase_boundary: dataset right-HS-to-right-HS segmentation, see Boo et al 2025
events_warning: 20N crossing only if observable; force plate zero is not foot airborne; foot side from CoP relative to heel/toe markers

mapping.pelvis: OpenSim intrinsic ZXY; T transform to MuJoCo

heading_alignment.operation: Single rigid world-frame yaw per stride; root XY reset to (0,0)
heading_alignment.qvel: Recomputed from aligned qpos using MuJoCo mj_differentiatePos
heading_alignment.note: For comparisons with retained OpenSim-lab marker/GRF coordinates, apply the documented OpenSim-to-MuJoCo basis change and this yaw/origin transform.

events.method: Boo et al 2025 (right foot): rising 20N vertical-GRF crossing=HS; falling=TO
events.stride_boundary: Published right-HS-to-right-HS segmentation (not necessarily visible in cropped GRF)

contact_event_rebuild.paper_definition: right HS / TO at 20 N vertical GRF (level walking)
contact_event_rebuild.additional_user_qc: 20 ms per plate refractory; S029/S115 false-HS exclusions; CoP side classification
contact_event_rebuild.left_side_events: extra inferred from CoP-to-foot-markers; NOT explicitly described by paper
